### Part A

```{r}
tab = matrix(c(1, 9, 7, 3), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
print(chisq.test(tab)$expected)
fit = fisher.test(tab, alternative = "two.sided")
cat(sprintf("p = %.6f\n", fit$p.value))
```

### Part B

```{r}
tab2 = matrix(c(30, 4, 12, 14), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
pA = sum(tab2[1, ]) / 60
pB = sum(tab2[, 1]) / 60
print(c(pA = pA, pB = pB, diff = pA - pB))
print(mcnemar.test(tab2, correct = TRUE))
print(binom.test(4, 4 + 12, p = 0.5, alternative = "two.sided"))
```
